params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 has no mission replay, but supports multiple saves Unlike GTA 5, GTA 6 does not let you replay story missions once they are done, as Eurogamer's reviewer confirmed over a 100+ hour playthrough. Players can keep multiple save files instead, and Rockstar says it made missions harder to fail. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 17:24 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👥 @RockstarGames 👎 React if you'll miss replays · 💬 Dealbreaker or no big deal? #GTA6 #Rockstar #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
